dedupe_keys.name: 2020 material flows of critical minerals in ev battery cathode supply chains cheng fuchs michalek karplus

description: This dataset gives 2020 country-to-country material flows of cobalt, nickel, manganese, phosphorus and lithium used in electric vehicle battery cathode materials, across the upstream and midstream steps of extraction and mining, refining and cathode production. The figshare page says the flows were generated from the International Trade Centre's TradeMap database and are published as one Sankey-ready CSV per mineral; it supports the 2024 Nature Communications paper by Cheng, Fuchs, Michalek and Karplus. It was published on 9 March 2024 by the authors as five downloadable CSV files of about 38 KB in total, free under CC BY 4.0, with global coverage by country. Caveats: it covers only 2020, trade statistics miss within-country flows and some re-exports, and the lithium file carries edits whose nature is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives a ready supply network of battery mineral flows to test chokepoints, export restrictions and disruption of refining or cathode production in one country. Related catalogue records include the USGS world minerals outlook to 2029, the USGS mineral commodity supply risk data and the BGS World Mineral Statistics.
